(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_

english.legislation: Contrary to sections 1,1A and 3 of the Criminal Law Act 1977.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
conspired with one or more persons
to assault a person
thereby occasioning him / her
actual bodily harm

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Where this offence is committed against an emergency worker this must be treated as an aggravating factor in sentencing, see section 67 of the Sentencing Act 2020.
(ii) Consent to serious harm for sexual gratification that has been obtained from the victim is not a defence that can be used by a suspect who has committed this offence - see section 71 of the Domestic Abuse Act 2021.
